name: Home and field services
description: Trades, local service businesses, and field operations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: service area
hasDefinedTerm.description: The geographic region a business will travel to serve. Defines realistic local targeting.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SAB
hasDefinedTerm.description: A business serving customers at their location rather than at a storefront. Listed without a public address.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Google Business Profile
hasDefinedTerm.description: The listing controlling how a business appears in maps and local results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: local pack
hasDefinedTerm.description: The map plus three business listings shown for local-intent queries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: NAP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Name, address, phone. Consistency across listings is a core local ranking signal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: citation
hasDefinedTerm.description: A mention of a business's name, address, and phone on a directory or site.

hasDefinedTerm.name: proximity
hasDefinedTerm.description: How close a searcher is to a business. Usually the strongest local ranking factor, and the one you cannot change.

hasDefinedTerm.name: review velocity
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly new reviews arrive. Steadier matters more than bursty.

hasDefinedTerm.name: review gating
hasDefinedTerm.description: Soliciting reviews only from satisfied customers. Prohibited by most major platforms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LSA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's pay-per-lead ad format for service businesses, requiring background screening.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Google Guaranteed
hasDefinedTerm.description: A badge on Local Services Ads indicating screening and a limited job-value guarantee.

hasDefinedTerm.name: lead
hasDefinedTerm.description: A prospective customer who has made contact but not yet booked.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cost per lead
hasDefinedTerm.description: Marketing spend divided by leads generated.

hasDefinedTerm.name: booked job rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of leads that convert into scheduled work.

hasDefinedTerm.name: average ticket
hasDefinedTerm.description: Average revenue per completed job.

hasDefinedTerm.name: truck roll
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sending a technician to a site. The main unit of cost in field service.

hasDefinedTerm.name: first-time fix rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of jobs resolved on the first visit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: dispatch
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assigning and routing technicians to jobs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: field service management
hasDefinedTerm.description: Software coordinating scheduling, dispatch, and invoicing for mobile crews.

hasDefinedTerm.name: estimate
hasDefinedTerm.description: A priced proposal for work, given before the job is accepted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: change order
hasDefinedTerm.description: A documented adjustment to agreed scope and price mid-job.

hasDefinedTerm.name: callback
hasDefinedTerm.description: A return visit to correct earlier work. Usually unpaid, and a direct margin loss.

hasDefinedTerm.name: warranty work
hasDefinedTerm.description: Repairs performed under an existing guarantee.

hasDefinedTerm.name: maintenance agreement
hasDefinedTerm.description: A recurring contract for scheduled servicing. The main route to predictable revenue in trades.

hasDefinedTerm.name: preventive maintenance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Scheduled servicing intended to avoid failures rather than respond to them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: emergency call-out
hasDefinedTerm.description: Unscheduled urgent work, usually priced at a premium.

hasDefinedTerm.name: licensed and bonded
hasDefinedTerm.description: Holding the required trade licence and a surety bond covering incomplete or defective work.

hasDefinedTerm.name: permit
hasDefinedTerm.description: Municipal authorization required before certain work may legally proceed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: inspection
hasDefinedTerm.description: An official check that completed work meets code.

hasDefinedTerm.name: code compliance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Conformance with the building or trade standards in force locally.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HVAC
hasDefinedTerm.description: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SEER
hasDefinedTerm.description: Seasonal energy efficiency ratio. A cooling efficiency rating for HVAC equipment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: hard water
hasDefinedTerm.description: Water with high mineral content, which scales fixtures and shortens appliance life.

hasDefinedTerm.name: backflow prevention
hasDefinedTerm.description: A device stopping contaminated water re-entering a clean supply.

hasDefinedTerm.name: load calculation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sizing equipment to a building's actual heating or cooling demand rather than by rule of thumb.

hasDefinedTerm.name: seasonality
hasDefinedTerm.description: Predictable demand swings across the year. The defining planning problem in most trades.

hasDefinedTerm.name: referral rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of new work arriving through existing customers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: before and after
hasDefinedTerm.description: Paired photos documenting completed work. The highest-converting content type in most trades.
